subject.title: [Security] Mitigating timing attacks in GitHub Auth OAuth callback validation

question: Does any current or shipped OpenClaw GitHub authentication path receive an OAuth callback with a caller-controlled `state` value, despite the bundled GitHub Copilot provider using device flow?
rationale: The reported paths and callback are not present on current main, but the protected security classification requires an owner to confirm the complete authentication boundary before closure.

options.title: Confirm no callback surface
options.body: Audit the GitHub auth entrypoints and close this issue if all supported flows are device-code or token-import based.

options.title: Route a concrete hardening fix
options.body: Identify the actual callback owner and replace its state comparison with `safeEqualSecret`, adding focused valid-state and invalid-state tests.

recommendation.title: Confirm no callback surface
recommendation.body: Audit the GitHub auth entrypoints and close this issue if all supported flows are device-code or token-import based.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work covers the shared timing-safe comparison helper and adjacent authentication checks.
